text:
Ivy Chen: Quick QBR flag  MarketMesh (SI) submitted a late MDF + runway ask. They want $29k to finish the connector sprint and 8-week runway for marketplace launch coordination.
Noah Green: Can you split the $29k? eng vs infra vs promo?
Ivy Chen: Breakdown: $17k eng hours, $6k staging infra credits, $4k co-marketing (webinar + one paid social burst), $2k contingency = $29k.
Priya Rao: Marketing: 8 weeks is longer than our usual max. We generally allow up to 6 weeks unless there's a product dependency. Why 8?
Ivy Chen: MarketMesh has a regional compliance review + translations for EU markets which adds 2 extra weeks. They want the tile to go live with translated assets.
Sam Ortiz: Finance: anything >= $30k needs Head + Finance. This is under $30k but we still need a scorecard waiver because MarketMesh is Tier Bronze. Provide KPIs.
Priya Rao: For runway extensions >6 weeks we need Marketing + Legal OK. Also ask for asset delivery dates. We can tentatively accept 8w if assets locked by week 5.
ops-bot: Policy excerpt: "Runway >6 weeks requires Marketing + Legal approval; MDF exceptions >= $30k require Head + Finance sign-off. All MDF requests must include measurable outcomes and rollback criteria." (https://redwood.company/policies/partnerships-qbr)
Noah Green: OK. Please prepare a 1-pager with: ask, timeline (asset dates), KPIs (MQLs, demo requests), feature-flag rollback plan, and staging dry-run date. Finance will do 48h review once posted.
Ivy Chen: Draft checklist (quick):
```
- Wk -8: NDA + translation backlog review
- Wk -6: Creative handoff + localized assets
- Wk -4: Staging dry-run (marketplace tile + translations)
- Day 0: Publish + partner webinar (localized)
- Wk +2: Attribution readout + bizdev handoff
```
Priya Rao: Add toggle controls for the tile and a stop criteria: untranslated impressions >0.5% or error rate >1% -> pause. Also require analytics hooks for attribution.
Sam Ortiz: Finance wants baseline metrics and expected pipeline $ over 3 months. If the combined monthly commitments push us over $50k, escalate to Exec.
Ivy Chen: Will attach MarketMesh scorecard and estimated pipeline in the 1-pager. Planning to post by EOD and tag Marketing + Finance.
Noah Green: Thanks  will review when posted. If anything creeps up, ping me.
Priya Rao: I can review assets and legal ok once the doc is up. We may shorten runway if translations lag.
Ivy Chen: Understood. Posting the 1-pager shortly. Thanks folks. :pray:
